Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Reuters reported the two-year Treasury yield jumped 13 basis points, the 10-year yield rose 9 basis points, the dollar index hit an 18-month high, and gold fell after the inflation report. The market reaction shows energy-driven inflation is now spilling into rate expectations. [1]
